RELIANCE.title: Growth across a large base
RELIANCE.text: FY25 gross revenue reached ₹10,71,174 crore, up 7.1% year on year. This is gross revenue, not net revenue from operations.

RELIANCE.title: Earnings grew more slowly than revenue
RELIANCE.text: Consolidated EBITDA rose 2.9% to ₹1,83,422 crore; profit after tax including associates rose 2.9% to ₹81,309 crore. The differing growth rates merit a closer look at segment mix.

RELIANCE.title: Jio and retail add a second lens
RELIANCE.text: FY25 Jio Platforms PAT was ₹26,109 crore, up 21.9%; Reliance Retail PAT was ₹12,392 crore, up 11.6%. These segment outcomes should be distinguished from group-level growth.

TCS.title: Margins improved despite weaker demand
TCS.text: FY26 adjusted operating margin reached 25.0%, compared with 24.3% in FY25: +70 basis points. FY26 excludes severance, legal provisions and India wage-code effects; the issuer reports the expansion on this basis.

TCS.title: Bookings and revenue tell different stories
TCS.text: FY26 constant-currency revenue declined 2.4%, while total contract value was $40.7 billion including five mega deals. Bookings are not recognized revenue.

TCS.title: A directional commitment with a measurable result
TCS.text: In April 2025, CFO Samir Seksaria said margins should improve. The annual reported operating margin subsequently rose. This does not establish that the wider 26% aspiration was achieved.

HDFCBANK.title: Read the bank through NII and NIM
HDFCBANK.text: Q4 FY25 standalone net interest income rose 10.3% to ₹32,070 crore. Net interest margin was 3.54% on total assets and 3.73% on interest-earning assets; these denominators are different.

HDFCBANK.title: Consolidated and standalone are separate views
HDFCBANK.text: Q4 FY25 consolidated profit after tax was ₹18,830 crore, using the press release’s rounded ₹188.3 billion figure. This should not be compared directly with standalone profit.

HDFCBANK.title: Watch the comparison base
HDFCBANK.text: The prior-year quarter included gains from the sale of HDFC Credila. Reported net revenue comparisons therefore need the context of that one-off transaction.

BHARTIARTL.title: Realization improved in India mobile
BHARTIARTL.text: Q4 FY25 mobile ARPU rose to ₹245 from ₹209 a year earlier. The release attributes India mobile revenue growth to tariff repair, smartphone additions and premiumization.

BHARTIARTL.title: Consolidation matters to the growth rate
BHARTIARTL.text: Consolidated quarterly revenue rose 27.3% to ₹47,876 crore. The company explicitly identifies the full-quarter impact of Indus Towers consolidation among the drivers.

BHARTIARTL.title: Keep EBITDA and EBITDAaL distinct
BHARTIARTL.text: Q4 FY25 consolidated EBITDA margin was 57.2%, while EBITDA after leases margin was 50.9%. Use matching definitions when comparing performance.

SUNPHARMA.title: Growth was led by specialty and India
SUNPHARMA.text: FY25 gross sales rose 9.0% to ₹52,041 crore. Global specialty sales rose 17.1% to $1,216 million, while India formulation sales grew 13.7%.

SUNPHARMA.title: Research spending came below the original range
SUNPHARMA.text: FY25 reported R&D investment was 6.2% of sales, below the earlier 8–10% spending range. Spending below plan is a variance, not a verdict on clinical execution.
SUNPHARMA.tags: R&D research guidance outcome promise management

SUNPHARMA.title: Reported profit needs exceptional-item context
SUNPHARMA.text: FY25 adjusted net profit rose 19.0%, while reported net profit was ₹10,929 crore. The quarterly release separates adjusted and reported profit, so those growth rates should not be interchanged.

LT.title: An urban transit order with a defined scope
LT.text: L&T’s Heavy Civil Infrastructure vertical secured part design and construction of a 15.1 km elevated viaduct and 10 stations for the Noida Metro Aqua Line extension.
LT.tags: business order revenue growth pipeline metro

LT.title: A range is not an exact contract price
LT.text: The company categorizes this as a Significant order, defined as ₹1,000–2,500 crore. The exact contract price is not disclosed in this filing. The disclosed completion timeline is 36 months.
LT.tags: order value guidance expect timeline execution risk

ledger.promise: yes, we should be able to improve margins.
ledger.speaker: Samir Seksaria · CFO
ledger.explanation: On the issuer’s stated basis, annual operating margin rose from 24.3% to 25.0%. FY26 excludes severance, legal provisions and India wage-code effects. Met applies to directional improvement on that basis; it does not imply the 26% aspiration was achieved.

ledger.promise: R&D investments will be 8% to 10% of sales for the next year.
ledger.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi · Managing Director
ledger.explanation: Reported R&D / sales of 6.2% was below the original 8–10% range. This is a spending variance, not a judgment on product development. The reported ratio uses the issuer’s sales basis; do not substitute gross sales.

ledger.promise: we expect high single-digit consolidated top line growth for FY'25.
ledger.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi · Managing Director
ledger.explanation: Gross sales grew approximately 9%, broadly consistent with the wording. The promise did not specify a numerical range or precise top-line accounting definition, so a binary pass/fail would overstate precision.
